conditions: The execution is a master under §7.6.1(3/5). The local object matches its accessibility level and was successfully initialized and still exists.
limitations: The sequence does not generalize to non-master executions. The detailed task-wait conditions are governed by §9.3, and object-level hook behavior and the timing of deallocation have separate rules.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: In the Ada 2022 Reference Manual, a master is finalized after completion and before leaving. Finalization first awaits dependent tasks, then finalizes each successfully initialized, still-existing object at the master's accessibility level.
